answer: Shared-fate audit: each key answers 3 tiny pings at VRF-random seconds per epoch, ~360 a month. Independent hosts miss ~1%, so two honest keys rarely miss together. Clones on one box, API account or uplink go dark at once: a kernel panic, rate limit or juniper router flap hits all. Keys whose miss logs mirror each other (Jaccard >0.5 over 30 days) merge into one seat. Pings missed by >5% of the network are ignored, so cloud-wide outages don't merge honest keys. Each alias needs its own host, provider and line, ~$40/month.
